_comment: iOS build settings that must survive `cap add ios`.
mobile/ios/ is gitignored and regenerated from Capacitor's stock template,
which pins IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET to the framework's own floor — 13.0
on Capacitor 6. Nothing in the repo said otherwise, so every regenerated
project went back to 13.0 and every upload drew the same App Store Connect
MinimumOSVersion too low. This app has a MinimumOSVersion of 13.0.
Starting in Spring 2027, all iOS apps must have a MinimumOSVersion of
15.0 or later in order to be uploaded to App Store Connect or submitted
It is a warning today and a rejection from Spring 2027.
iOS 15 runs on the iPhone 6s and later, so raising the floor from 13 gives
up devices Apple stopped supporting in 2021. Set deliberately rather than
inherited: this is the version the app is tested against and the one the
The Podfile needs the same number, and a post_install hook, because pods
carry their own deployment targets and a pod built for 13.0 pulls the
archive's effective minimum back down. apply:ios writes all three places.
Run `npm run apply:ios` after changing this, then `npm run check:ios`.
